semiconductor_relevance: High — Paragon Technologies specializes in the R&D and manufacturing of Silicon Carbide (SiC) wafers, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Paragon Technologies Co., Ltd. is a leader in the development and production of Silicon Carbide (SiC) wafers, leveraging advanced PVD vacuum sputtering technology for EMI/ESD solutions in 3C products. The company offers vertically integrated services from R&D and design to mass production, aiming to establish a high-specification, high-yield integrated production system in Taiwan.
capabilities: PVD vacuum sputtering technology for EMI/ESD solutions
R&D and manufacturing of Silicon Carbide (SiC) wafers

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is focused on building Taiwan's first high-specification, high-yield integrated production system.
